400.title: Bad request
400.description: The request could not be understood by the server.

401.title: Unauthorized
401.description: You need to sign in to access this page.

403.title: Access denied
403.description: You don't have permission to view this page.

404.title: Not found
404.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.

429.title: Too many requests
429.description: You've made too many requests. Please slow down and try again.

500.title: Server error
500.description: Something went wrong on our end. Please try again later.

502.title: Bad gateway
502.description: The server received an invalid response. Please try again.

503.title: Service unavailable
503.description: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
